scripts.text: The kind of items you have is too various. Retry after reducing the sort of items.
scripts.translation: 您攜帶的物品種類太多，請整理物品欄後再試。

scripts.text: You are overburdened, so you cannot proceed it anymore. Please try again after reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
Huhu. Did you bring some coins? I would sell anything but my soul if you have coins.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
呵呵。你帶了硬幣嗎？只要你有硬幣，除了靈魂之外，我什麼都賣。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Closed Mind Box (100 Coins)
scripts.translation: 心門緊閉箱（100枚硬幣）

scripts.text: Lush Rose (500 Coins)
scripts.translation: 新鮮玫瑰（500枚硬幣）

scripts.translation: (時裝)新鮮的玫瑰（1000枚硬幣）

scripts.translation: (時裝)聖誕老人玩偶發箍（500枚硬幣）

scripts.translation: (時裝)紅色無邊軟帽（500枚硬幣）

scripts.text: Old Parasol (1000 Coins)
scripts.translation: 老舊陽傘（1000枚硬幣）

scripts.text: Hot Tea (7 Coins)
scripts.translation: 溫暖紅茶（7枚硬幣）

scripts.text: Sweet Canape (5 Coins)
scripts.translation: 甜蜜餅乾（5枚硬幣）

scripts.text: Holy Water (1 Coin)
scripts.translation: 聖水（1枚硬幣）

scripts.text: Water Of Darkness (1 Coin)
scripts.translation: 黑暗之水（1枚硬幣）

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
Khaha, do you feel any scruples or something? Alright, then. Come again at anytime when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
咔哈哈，有什麼顧慮嗎？
行吧，等你改變主意，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
You need ^0000ff{0}^000000 Bloody Coins to buy ^0000ff{1}^000000. Are you going to buy it?
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Purchase
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
Khaha, what a fickle friend you are. If you really decide to buy it, come again.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
咔哈哈，你還真善變。
決定要買了再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
You have paid for it. I look forward to seeing you again.!
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
錢收到了，期待下次光臨！

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
You need ^0000ff{0}^000000 Bloody Coins to buy ^0000ff{1}^000000. You are short of them.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
需要^0000ff{0}^000000枚沾血硬幣才能購買^0000ff{1}^000000。
你的硬幣不夠啊。

scripts.text: The kind of items you have is too various. Retry after reducing the sort of items.
scripts.translation: 您攜帶的物品種類太多，請整理物品欄後再試。

scripts.text: You are overburdened, so you cannot proceed it anymore. Please try again after reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Oh, I'm sure that you came here because you don't like ordinaries. Just talk to me. I will make anything if you have prepared the reasonable charge and the proper materials.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
哦，來找我的人，想必都不喜歡平庸的東西。
儘管開口，只要報酬和材料合適，什麼我都能做。

scripts.text: Nothing that I want.
scripts.translation: 我沒有什麼想要的

scripts.text: I want Celine's Ribbon.
scripts.translation: 我想要席琳的蝴蝶結

scripts.text: I'm seeking Noble Cross.
scripts.translation: 我在尋找榮耀十架

scripts.text: I'd like to get Evilspirit Gloves.
scripts.translation: 我想獲得惡靈手套

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Yes, yes. Everyone says like you at first. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
好好好，大家一開始都這麼說。
回頭見。

[Vagrant Cain]

scripts.translation: 馬上兌換

[Vagrant Cain]
Come back when you are ready. Let me remind you of the materials.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
等你準備好了再來吧。讓我提醒你一下需要的材料。

[Vagrant Cain]

scripts.text: I will try it next time
scripts.translation: 我下次再來

scripts.text: Exchange them right away
scripts.translation: 馬上兌換

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Okay, you are determined. Hope we can see each other next time, huhu.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
好，看來你已經下定決心了。
希望下次還能見面，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The hat you wear is not Lush Rose. Bring me the right material that I told you, kukuku.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
你戴的不是新鮮玫瑰。
把我說的材料帶對了再來，嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The hat you wear is not refined to +9 or greater. You cannot trade with that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
你戴的帽子還沒精煉到+9，不能用來兌換。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Well, you are short of Bloody Coins. You need to gather exactly 1000 of them. Less than that.. It can't be helped.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
嗯，沾血硬幣不夠。
要湊齊1000枚，少一枚都不行...我也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The deal has completed. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
交易完成，看看成品吧。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The thing on your right hand is not Grand Cross (slot). Bring me the right thing I told you, kuku.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
你右手拿的不是聖錘 十字星（有孔）。
把我說的東西帶對了再來，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Well, you are short of Bloody Coins. You need to gather exactly 2000 of them. Less than that.. It can't be helped.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
嗯，沾血硬幣不夠。
要湊齊2000枚，少一枚都不行...我也沒辦法。

[Vagrant Cain]
The deal has completed. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
交易完成，看看成品吧。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You don't have enough materials.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
你的材料不夠。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The deal has completed. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
交易完成，看看成品吧。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You should prepare ^0000ff1000 ^000000Bloody Coins, one ^0000ffHurt Mind, Kind Heart, and Red Lantern ^000000each for ^0000ffEvilspirit Gloves^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凱恩]
準備好^0000ff1000^000000枚沾血硬幣，以及^0000ff受傷的心、宅心仁厚和紅色手提燈^000000各一個，就能兌換^0000ff惡靈手套^000000。

scripts.text: The kind of items you have is too various. Retry after reducing the sort of items.
scripts.translation: 您攜帶的物品種類太多，請整理物品欄後再試。

scripts.text: You are overburdened, so you cannot proceed it anymore. Please try again after reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Huhu, humanbeing's greed is naturally wantless. What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
呵呵，人類的貪慾真是永無止境。
想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text: What can you do for me?
scripts.translation: 你能幫我做什麼？

scripts.text: Enchant accessory of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工廠的飾品

scripts.text: Enchant weapon of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工廠的武器

scripts.text: Enchant headgear of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工廠的頭飾

scripts.text: Enchant footwear of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工廠的鞋子

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
What do I do? That's really simple. You just bring me Bloody Coins and I will get them and enchant your accessory.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
我能做什麼？很簡單。
帶沾血硬幣來，付給我，我就幫你給飾品附魔。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I will take 15 Bloody Coins for each try. I will enchant one slot amount for every 15 Coins. Of course, 3 is the maximum.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
每次收15枚沾血硬幣，附魔一個插槽，最多可以附魔三個插槽。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Well, it is so natural that the destruction rate will get higher as the upgrade level increases. I would recommend you to stop first or second try, tee-hee.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
附魔次數越多，裝備損壞的風險自然越高。
我勸你附魔一兩次就收手吧，嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Oh, you are equipped with ^0000ffNoble Cross^000000! This thing need to find someone else to enchant it.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
哦，你裝備了^0000ff榮耀十架^000000！這東西需要找別人來附魔。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I've tried several times, but have no luck.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
我試過幾次，都沒成功。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
If you want to enchant this weapon, find ^0000ffMayomayo^000000 in Malangdo island! He should be able to do it.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
如果你想附魔這把武器，去綿綿島找^0000ff馬約馬約^000000！他應該能做到。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
You can choose one of 2 types and the fee for each try is 15 Bloody Coins.. I will get them right before enchanting it.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
你可以從兩種型別中選擇一種，每次嘗試的費用是15枚沾血硬幣。我會在附魔前收取它們。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: A random stat one among STR/AGI/DEX
scripts.translation: 隨機提升力量/敏捷/靈巧之一

scripts.text: A random stat among INT/VIT/DEX
scripts.translation: 隨機提升智力/體力/靈巧之一

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Okay, come again when you are willing to, kuku.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
好，想做了再來，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This equipment is not from Toy Factory. I can handle the items from Toy Factory only.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
這件裝備不是來自玩具工廠。我只能處理玩具工廠的物品。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ho~ This has already reached the peak. It is impossible to higher enchant, so be content and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
嚯~已經附魔到頂了，沒法再提升了。
知足吧，好好用。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Okay, let's try the first enchantment. Usually, they are not broken. About 95% success rate?
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
好，先來第一次附魔。
一般不會弄壞，成功率大概有95%吧？

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ho~ Second enchantment. Now it became dangerous. The success rate is about 70%. Do you want continue? The whole accessory will be blown if fail.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
嚯~第二次附魔，這下開始有風險了。
成功率大約70%，要繼續嗎？
失敗的話，整個飾品都會毀掉。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This is the last enchantment. Will you keep going? At this time, ^ff0000the success rate is below 50%^000000. Of course, it would be great if it is successfull... Hmm, I will follow your descision, but keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
這是最後一次附魔，還要繼續嗎？
這次^ff0000成功率不到50%^000000。
成功當然很好...嗯，決定權在你，可得想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This equipment is not from Toy Factory. I can handle the items from Toy Factory only.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
這件裝備不是來自玩具工廠。我只能處理玩具工廠的物品。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I enchant weapons only once. There's no failure, so you can just think of it as the bonus effect, tee-hee.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
武器只能附魔一次，但保證不會失敗，就當是額外的好處吧，嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This equipment is not from Toy Factory. I can handle the items from Toy Factory only.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
這件裝備不是來自玩具工廠。我只能處理玩具工廠的物品。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ho~ This has already reached the peak. It is impossible to higher enchant, so be content and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
嚯~已經附魔到頂了，沒法再提升了。
知足吧，好好用。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Good. Let's start the first enchantment. I will add one of the special battle effects. Of course, you don't have to be afraid because there's no failure, kuku.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
好，先來第一次附魔。
我會新增一種特殊戰鬥效果，不會失敗，放心吧，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
The second enchantment. I will buff one of the previous states. There also is no failure, so don't worry, kukuku
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
第二次附魔，我會提升一種屬性。
這次也不會失敗，別擔心，嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I don't enchant this!
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
我不附魔這個！

scripts.text: I will com back later
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text: Please do it
scripts.translation: 請開始吧

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
{0}

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
There is a problem, please come back again!
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
出了點問題，請重新來一次！

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I don't know what this is, but I think this isn't thing I could handle.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
不知道這是什麼，反正我好像處理不了。

scripts.text: [Black Beard Joe]
scripts.translation: [黑鬍子 喬]

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ouch! Poor you, the enchantment has failed and your gear is broken, Geez!
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
哎喲，真倒霉！附魔失敗，裝備也毀了，嘖！

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Hmm.. It was successful. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
嗯...成功了。看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Hmm.. By the way, you need to fill up Bloody Coins. You cannot even pay for the fee.
scripts.translation:
[黑鬍子 喬]
嗯...你得再去攢些沾血硬幣了，連費用都付不起啊。
